Quantix Table Lamp With Phone Stand – Smart Touch Lamp with Flexible Neck

The Quantix Table Lamp With Phone Stand is a modern, multifunctional lighting solution designed for work, study, and everyday convenience. Combining elegant design with smart functionality, this lamp features a touch switch, 3 color mode light, rechargeable design, and a flexible neck for adjustable illumination. Ideal for desks, bedside tables, and office setups, it also doubles as a phone stand and pen stand, helping you stay organized and productive.

Crafted for modern lifestyles, the Quantix lamp delivers efficient LED lighting while saving space. Whether you are reading, studying, attending video calls, or charging your workspace aesthetics, this smart table lamp is designed to enhance comfort and usability.

Smart Touch Switch & 3 Color Mode Light

The advanced touch switch table lamp allows effortless operation with a single tap. Switch between warm light, neutral light, and cool white light using the built-in 3 color mode light feature. Each lighting mode is carefully calibrated to suit different activities such as reading, working, relaxing, or night use.

Rechargeable Design for Cordless Convenience

Featuring a long-lasting built-in battery, this eliminates the need for constant plugging. The cordless functionality makes it perfect for flexible placement anywhere in your home or office. The energy-efficient LED technology ensures extended usage with minimal power consumption.

Designed to maximize desk efficiency, the includes a sturdy that holds your smartphone securely for video calls, watching content, or notifications. The built-in pen stand keeps stationery organized, making it an ideal desk lamp for office and study table.

Flexible Neck for Adjustable Lighting Angle

The allows you to easily adjust the light direction according to your needs. Whether you need focused lighting for reading or broader illumination for work, the adjustable neck provides complete control while maintaining stability.

Minimal Design with Maximum Utility

With its sleek and modern appearance, this blends seamlessly with contemporary interiors. It is suitable as a study lamp for students, a bedside lamp, or a work desk lamp. The compact footprint ensures it occupies minimal space while offering maximum functionality.

Key Features & Benefits

  • Smart touch switch for easy operation
  • 3 color mode light – warm, neutral, and cool white
  • Built-in phone stand for hands-free viewing
  • Integrated pen stand for desk organization
  • Energy-efficient LED lighting
  • Rechargeable design for cordless use
  • Flexible neck for adjustable lighting angles
  • Ideal for office, study table, bedroom, and home use

Perfect for Multiple Use Cases

This multifunctional is perfect for students, professionals, and home users looking for a reliable lighting solution with added utility. Use it as a reading lamp, office desk lamp, or even as a compact night lamp. Its eye-friendly lighting reduces strain during long hours of use.

The stands out with its combination of smart features, durable build, and user-centric design. It is an excellent choice for anyone seeking a modern, rechargeable that enhances productivity while keeping the workspace organized. Upgrade your desk with a lighting solution that delivers comfort, efficiency, and style. Choose Quantix for smarter illumination and everyday convenience.
